name: levelrail-mcp

tools.name: deploy_app
tools.description: Point an app at a new image tag. Asynchronous: watch get_app_status, or wait=true for the outcome and failure diagnosis. Protected environments need confirm and wait for another human's approval.

confirm.description: true to confirm a protected environment, else 409

image.description: image reference to deploy, e.g. registry.example.com/org/app:tag

tools.name: diagnose_app_failure
tools.description: Why an app's latest deploy failed or it crashloops: typed causes (WRONG_PORT, OOM_KILLED) with evidence and fixes. Pass deploy_id for a past attempt.

deploy_id.description: diagnose this specific past deploy attempt instead of the app's newest one

tools.name: disable_toolset
tools.description: Remove toolsets' tools from this session's tool list.

tools.name: enable_toolset
tools.description: Add toolsets' tools to this session's tool list.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get one app's current desired state: image, port, domains, env, resources, health checks, command override, volumes, bind mounts.

tools.name: get_app_env
tools.description: Get an app's plain env vars and the names (never values) of its secrets and sensitive vars. Use before set_app_env or unset_app_env.

tools.name: get_app_status
tools.description: Get an app's current reconcile conditions (type, status, reason, message). Current status only, not history.

tools.name: get_attention
tools.description: Everything needing attention, critical first: failing apps, offline nodes, certificates, warnings, backups, pending items. Only what the token may read.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List apps (name, image, port, domains, limits), 50 per page. Pass next_offset as offset for more.

tools.name: list_deploys
tools.description: List an app's deploy and reconcile conditions. Same data as get_app_status: there is no separate deploy history.

tools.name: list_toolsets
tools.description: List toolsets with tool count and token cost. Enable one with enable_toolset.

tools.name: preflight_app
tools.description: Read-only pre-deploy checks of an app's config: DNS, port, disk, memory, image pull, repo, env, mounts, each with a fix hint. Pass required_env to verify names.

required_env.description: env var names that must be set for the app to start

tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Search an app's logs by level, time window, deploy and text, returning a capped excerpt of the newest matches plus counts. Prefer this over get_app_logs.

deploy_id.description: only lines from this deploy attempt's window (from list_deploy_attempts)

level.description: minimum level: trace, debug, info, warn, error or fatal; lines with no detectable level are excluded

max_lines.description: most recent lines to return, default 100; output is also capped in bytes

since.description: start of the window: a duration like 30m or an RFC3339 time; default 1h

until.description: end of the window: a duration ago or an RFC3339 time; default now

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search apps, databases, nodes, domains, templates, deployments, settings and docs at once. Returns only what the token may see.

kind.description: limit to one kind: app, database, node, domain, template, deployment, setting, doc, action

query.description: scopes app: env: tag: node: kind: then free text, e.g. 'env:prod api'

tools.name: set_app_domains
tools.description: Replace an app's domain list, changing nothing else. A domain owned by another app is refused with a conflict and nothing changes.

domains.description: the app's complete domain list; replaces the current one, so include domains to keep

tools.name: set_app_env
tools.description: Set one environment variable on an app. With secret true the value is encrypted and write-only. Takes effect on the next deploy_app or restart_app.

force.description: secret only: overwrite even if the key is locked

secret.description: store the value envelope-encrypted as a write-only secret instead of a plain env var

value.description: the value to store; never returned or logged

tools.name: unset_app_env
tools.description: Remove one environment variable from an app, plain or secret. Saved to desired state only: the container keeps its old environment until deploy_app or restart_app.

force.description: secret only: remove even if the key is locked

key.description: the environment variable name to remove

secret.description: remove a secret (and undeclare it) instead of a plain env var

tools.name: wait_for_deploy
tools.description: Wait for a deploy to finish: healthy, failed, canceled, superseded or blocked (with the failure). Blocks about 55 seconds; returns in_progress if still running, call again.

deploy_id.description: the deploy attempt id, or latest (default); latest is resolved once so a newer deploy cannot take over

max_wait_seconds.description: block at most this long, capped by the server limit (default 55)

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which identity this connection authenticates as: kind, name, abilities and expiry.
